text: Cognee exposes four operations: remember, recall, forget, and enhance.
The cognee Python package version is 1.1.0, released in April 2026.
At query time, skills are selected by their IDs using the skills parameter.
When the success score of a skill falls below 0.5, Cognee generates a SkillImprovementProposal.
The CLI for Cognee is called cognee-cli, and it supports the operations remember, recall, and delete.
With REDIS_URL set, Cognee uses Redis as the session-memory layer.
Cognee allows up to 100 MB of stored memory and 1,000 queries per day on the free tier.
The default distance metric for HNSW indexing in Redis is set to cosine.
The Python package supports versions 3.10 through 3.12.
Running cognee-cli -ui serves a local web UI at http://localhost:3000.
